annotation: Beitrag zur Sammlung »The Progress of English Poetry« (INr 130152, Obj 15)
incipit_statement: Thou brightest virgin daughter of the Skies, / Made in the last promotion of the bless’d / Whose palms, new pluck’d from Paradise; / In spreading branches more sublimely rise
preferred_title: An ode to the pious memory of that accomplished / young Lady / MRS. ANNE KILLIGREW, / Excellent in the two sister-arts of Poesy and Painting
